title: ChatCRM
description: Shared WhatsApp inbox for teams: every conversation is assigned to an agent and becomes a measurable customer.
role: Main author of the API and app
problem: WhatsApp messages landed on a single phone; nobody knew who answered or how long it took.
approach: Signed Cloud API webhooks, BullMQ queues, real time over Socket.IO, credentials encrypted with AES-256-GCM and Zod contracts shared by API and app.
result: In production as internal software since 2025, with 130 test suites in the API.

title: Tribu
description: TypeScript SDK that issues electronic payment documents to SUNAT in a single call.
problem: Issuing an invoice means computing IGV, writing UBL XML, signing, zipping, sending it over SOAP and decoding the answer.
approach: A one-call API that checks SUNAT's rules before sending and returns a plain JSON Record.
result: SUNAT's beta environment accepts every document type it issues.

title: assess (ax)
description: Classroom exams from one laptop: the teacher supervises in the terminal and students answer from any browser on the LAN.
problem: Exam platforms require internet, accounts and installing software on every classroom machine.
approach: A single Go binary that embeds the React app, stores everything in SQLite and applies fair anti-cheat based only on what the browser can see.
result: Runs on Windows, Linux and macOS, even from a USB stick, with no internet.

title: Lumio
description: Transparent electricity-bill calculator for Peru: kWh to soles and back.
problem: The bill folds energy, fixed charge, public lighting and IGV into one hard-to-predict number.
approach: Exact, invertible formula, live breakdown and CI to GitHub Pages, with no backend or accounts.
result: Converting back and forth always returns the original value.

title: Invoicing ERP
description: Management Kanban with audit tables inside an invoicing ERP used by 3 companies.
problem: The invoice list took 4 to 5 minutes to load.
approach: Rewritten queries and caching; development and deployment environments in Docker.
resultsCaption: measured in production, J&P Periféricos SAC.

title: Reproducible research pipeline
description: Paper monorepo where every figure comes from a versioned pipeline, with CI validating DOIs, layout and builds.
problem: Paper results were copied by hand from notebooks and nobody could get them again.
approach: A manifest per paper, executable notebooks, validation scripts and CI on every change.
result: 2 papers published in Q1 Frontiers journals in 2026.

title: Canchán potato price forecasting
description: Comparison of SARIMAX, RNN, LSTM and hybrids on MIDAGRI 2020–2025 data.
problem: Forecasting monthly crop prices from short, noisy series.
approach: Prioritising stability and real generalisation over minimum error.
result: LSTM-XGBoost was the most robust model.

title: Carrion's disease profiles
description: Unsupervised clustering of 43,000+ records (2000–2024) for public-health surveillance.
problem: Understanding an endemic disease from mixed (numeric and categorical) data.
approach: FAMD dimensionality reduction + K-Means, compared with other combinations.

title: ChatCRM AI: Spanish sentiment
description: FastAPI service that scores the sentiment of every customer message with a Spanish-trained transformer.
result: Feeds the conversation view and the metrics dashboard.
